# HarvestRules

**Tags:** `harvest`

Tuning for working and moving a creature body: how long a harvest takes, how close the harvester stands, how carrying and dragging slow the walk, and how many bodies a region keeps.

> **Goal:** Keep harvest and carry numbers in the design bible so balance is a single-source edit

## Fields

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| ---- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `harvestSeconds` | decimal | yes | Seconds a harvest action runs; moving or taking damage cancels it |
| `harvestRangeMetres` | decimal | yes | Distance in metres within which the host accepts a harvest or carry intent |
| `carrySlowAboveFraction` | decimal | yes | Carrying a body heavier than this fraction of the capacity slows walking |
| `carrySlowSpeedMultiplier` | decimal | yes | Walk speed multiplier while carrying above carrySlowAboveFraction |
| `dragCapacityFactor` | decimal | yes | A `drag` body up to capacity times this factor can be dragged |
| `dragSpeedMultiplier` | decimal | yes | Walk speed multiplier while dragging a body |
| `carryBonusPerSkinningLevelKg` | decimal | yes | Extra carry capacity in kg per Skinning level (no strength attribute exists yet) |
| `maxCarcassesPerRegion` | integer | yes | Bodies a region keeps; the oldest decays first |
